variants.headline: Illness spreads beyond the clinics' reach
variants.body: Illness is spreading, with {sick} people too ill to work and {district} worst affected. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: {district} bears the worst of the pandemic
variants.body: The worst affected district is {district}, while illness leaves {sick} people unable to work. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
